items.text: We would like to inform you of several important changes coming with the major update scheduled for Tuesday, December 8 (JST).

notes.title: 1. Uncle Reset and the Season System

items.text: "Uncle Reset," which resets player progress at the start of each season, will occur one final time at the start of the next season.
After that, an "Infinity Season" with no end date will begin, and no further Uncle Resets will take place.

Please note that the Power Pack and Power-Up Support Pack included in certain editions, which used to be distributed at the start of each season, will only be granted once upon the initial claim after the Infinity Season begins.
The Duo Mode matchmaking system will transition from the current game-server-based system to a system that uses Epic Online Services (EOS).
Matchmaking works as usual, and no account registration is required.
The Duo Mode server architecture will transition from the current Dedicated Server model to a Listen Server model, in which the host player's device acts as the server.
Our development and operations teams will continue working hard to ensure you can enjoy LET IT DIE: INFERNO for a long time to come.
We have released Patch 1.3.1.0, which includes the following fixes and improvements.
The Raider Names of the top 10 donors in the Raiders Fund ranking at the end of Season 3 have been added to the in-game credits.
The departure animation that plays when setting out on an exploration can now be skipped.
We have made the following adjustments based on player feedback and gameplay data.
The Magnetic Staff will no longer be selected as a weapon in Death Jamboree and KIL Matches.
The difficulty level of the Avalanche Valley exploration stage was higher than expected and has been adjusted.
The battle item Oasis is once again available for purchase at Pro Shop Kazoku.
Fixed an issue where SPLithium was not being displayed correctly in the rankings when exceeding a certain amount.
Fixed an issue that caused the Mironette and Berserk Mironette stages to appear abnormally bright.
Fixed an issue where eating a Chocomole in some stages could sometimes fail to warp the player to an Escape Pod.
Various other bug fixes.
We have released Patch 1.3.0.0, which includes the following fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Major PvE Overhaul for Hell Gate!

items.text: You can now choose from multiple stages based on your Body Rank!
Clear stages to unlock new ones! Over 20 stages in total!
Complete unique missions in each stage and fight your way to survival!
The deeper you go, the more dramatically the stages transform!
Discover new scenery, with stages covered in autumn leaves, mycelium, and more!
Various parameters have been significantly adjusted for the PvE-focused experience!
Riff Type
A Hell Gate performer who controls other Yuckies. You’ll need to get creative to take it down!
Rider Type
A crazed rider mounted atop Pseudo-type Yuckies. Watch out for its wide range of attacks!
Raiders
You can now fight Raiders in PvE-focused Hell Gate, too!
They can use skills and battle items just like players!

notes.title: An enhanced version of Gomamusha awaits in the deepest parts of Hell Gate!

items.text: Gomamusha is more terrifying and powerful than ever! Do you have what it takes to defeat it?

notes.title: New Weapons: the Chemical Popper and the Chela!

Deathblow: Slam a high-pressure stream of toxic fluid into the ground, unleashing a shockwave of Corruption.

Armor inspired by the all-knowing Meijin! Some say they found it in certain stages!

releases.displayName: Season 3 of LET IT DIE: INFERNO: Hell Gate's Biggest Update Yet!

items.text: Season 3 of LET IT DIE: INFERNO has arrived with the biggest patch to date! This new season will run from June 9, 2026, to Sept. 7, 2026 (before maintenance).

And... The Yotsuyama are here...??! Somehow, they’ve found Hell Gate, bringing along with them their laboratory and all of its mycological bioweapons. Find your bearings in a new map, develop battle strategies with two new bodies, and enrich your fighting style with three new weapons. But that’s not all!
There’s a hell of a lot to look forward to in this new season, so keep reading for more information on what’s been added.
Welcome two new bodies, Joe and Inva, to Hell Gate.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45792505/0fc43d5987864af72334c9952c060f5b3feef160.png"]
A silent expert in explosive demolition. Joe can be acquired through the new Raiders Fund system introduced this season.
The first alien to join the Raiders’ ranks! Using her third eye, Inva can seize enemies in place with her Chronos Lock skill. She can be acquired by defeating Dreamseeker, the first boss.

Travel further into Hell Gate’s depths with the new map, Yotsuyama Castle. The second area of the Demon Gate Labyrinth, the ominous castle holds countless enemies within, like powerful Yotsuyama Heavy Sentry, General, and the new boss Gomamusha.
The second area of the Hell Rift has also been updated with new stages, complete with new lock-based mechanics that will make for a more challenging experience.

Raiders unite! Season 3 introduces a new Raiders Fund system, in which players can donate Kill Coins to one another in exchange for rewards. There will also be a World Reward system in which all players can collectively contribute to unlocking rewards.
The reward for Season 3 unlocks the new body, Joe!
Starting Season 3, switch masteries for any of your existing bodies (Timothy, Pearl, Patrick, Milene, Sasuke, and Ten). Each body also has an additional mastery option.
The mastery tree has also been redesigned to make stat differences clearer between builds.
Season 3 introduces three new weapons to your arsenal: Metal Whip, Plasma Laser, and Executioner.
Great for wide frontal attacks, the Metal Whip is equipped with a deathblow that unleashes four consecutive powerful, ground-ripping strikes.
Execute enemies with precision using the Plasma Laser. Charge up the laser to customize its range and power scaling, and perform a deathblow that features a powerful, sustained long-range laser beam.

Become a harbinger of death with the Executioner, a weapon that can chain up to four follow-up attacks after a heavy swing. When executing a deathblow, this weapon siphons energy from the Earth’s depths to bring annihilation to your enemies.
Stay alive in style in Hell Gate with three new armor sets introduced this season: Signalcade Armor, Kurohatsu Armor, and Strong Plated Armor.
Alert your enemies to the swift death you are about to bring them with the Signalcade Armor set, a traffic-controller-style armor set with eye-catching fluorescent colors.
Originally worn by the Yotsuyama Heavy Sentry, this armor set will keep you protected as you brave the halls of Yotsuyama Castle.
A pro-wrestler-themed armor set symbolizing the inner conflict between justice and desire.

notes.title: New Maps Added: Death Jamboree & KIL League

items.text: Season 3 adds new maps to both Death Jamboree and KIL League game modes. You can now also select Death Jamboree stages in Room Match.
Players will now also be able to see logs displaying recently played matches along with a list of players in the matchmaking queue upon arriving in Iron Perch.
Jam out to two new tracks in Season 3, along with 11 tracks from DEATHVERSE: LET IT DIE!
Also starting this season, set the vibe for your Hell Gate exploration by selecting your BGM track for Iron Perch and exploration from the Settings menu.
Upon clearing the River of Souls, receive special colors for the starting body as a reward.
Test your luck against the more powerful, new River of Souls boss Berserk Mironette.
Hide Raider IDs (including during duo play) from the Settings menu.
Season 3 Start Dash Event
Clear the River of Souls within the event period and receive the charm Raider Medal: 2nd Era. Rewards can be claimed via in-game mail after clearing.
New reading materials added
Season 3 item: “Uncle’s Sunglasses” added
DLSS Frame Generation Support has been added
PvE Solo Exploration no longer requires PS Plus (only for PS5)
Check out the roadmap below to get a birds-eye view of the season and all that’s to come.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45792505/4a9f1c2ce0690446dd7ddffaa6300ccfe99c7b06.jpg"]
We are continuing to mold the game based on community feedback generously provided in our AMAs and in Steam discussion forums!
What do you think about the new season? Share your thoughts with us via Bluesky, X, Instagram, and Facebook.
